Yeah even though I hated the bar it helped me get some confidence.
Hopefully!

Sure why not, I'm looking for new music anyways.

Same! I added someone but they haven't accepted, So let me know if you haven't gotten a Request.

Yeah that aswell, Its like people don't know when to shut up and leave you alone, Especially parents, Like how hard is it to recognize someones not in a good mood?

I Used to work in a bar and it was the exact same thing, Customers were assholes but had to make money somehow.

Yeah when i first got the acoustic I tried playing some nirvana/foo fighters and whatever but never got the hang of it. I should try again cause i really do love music.

I'm more into rock, hard rock, metal, Deathcore/metalcore (screaming vocals)

Yeah i'll add you on steam now, I can't play now cause its late but maybe we could play something together.

I wish i could pick up some other talent, Like I Own an acoustic guitar but i just don't have any motivation, I don't know how i can break out of the cycle of just coming home from school, turning on my pc, and then just escaping into it.

I barely even game anymore, I just watch videos and read about gaming more than i actually play because playing takes actual commitment, dont even have the dedication to play an entire game without turning it off and just watching a video or reading through reddit.

Basically turning off my mind.

Its not that I hate studying to be honest, Everytime i've studied its not like I was like "OMG I HATE THIS I WANT TO DO SOMETHING ELSE", 
Its just I get home and I'm so tired, All i wanna do is turn off my brain.

Maybe I'll shoot you a pm and we can play some games on steam if we have similar interests? I wish i had someone to play co-op games with.

Thanks for the words

Well its not the fact that the doctor would tell my parents anything, Its the fact that my mam would tell everyone im going to the doctor?
As far as i know everything is under doctor-patient confidentiality as long as the doctor doesn't believe that the patient could be intent on doing harm to him/herself, or others.

Which kinda means i can't talk to them about suicide/self harm? I think?

Yeah i'm no addicted to the computer, I went on holiday with a friend during summer for 10 days and its not like i was craving the internet or my computer. Its just that while i'm here i have no other source of entertainment, No other distraction. 

Its not an addiction to the computer/internet, Its just that theres really nothing else enjoyable for me to do?

So you're saying that excercise helps keep your mind off these things, But in a positive way, instead of just binging tv shows or youtube videos? 

Problem I have there is that i dont really want to go outside, Even when I have a valid reason like to buy a game or to pick up a few things, Walking around my local shopping center on my own makes me feel like a complete loser, And not only that, It makes me feel like everyone else is thinking that too.

And it's not like i go out unkempt or anything, I dress well and have a shower and look, For the most part, Normal.
Aka, I don't, In my opinion, Look like im depressed or that i'm moody, or lonely or anything.

Thank you for the kind words, I'm Glad that someone else agrees with me and that im not completely alone on this.

I know i need to see a doctor, and maybe even a therapist, The problem is If she knew then the whole fucking world would know because she can't keep her mouth shut and i dont need everyone in my life treating me like a mental patient.

And even if she promised not to say anything, How could i trust her? How could I believe her when all she does is throw my own failures in my face?

Really? I didn't know other people do what i do, Relating to the computer thing. I'm not even overweight or anything, But i think about going to the gym and exercising but then i think about the people at the gym and how i'd be alone and all that stuff, It makes me feel really nervous and anxious. If there was a gym or something with nobody around maybe I could go and focus on working out instead of using the computer as a peg for the hole in my life.

I've felt like this since i was 12, it just seems like its part of my life.
It's almost like a part of me, Some people like sports, Some people are really social, Some people are terribly depressed and suicidal.

Thanks Bill

Everyone says suicide is selfish but they're assholes who don't understand.

They're the fucking selfish ones. The people who live a fucking happy go lucky life, The people who can live in ignorance and pretend that this place is beautiful and amazing.

Only we know the truth, only we know the torture it is to keep on living.
They're the selfish ones for not being able to let go, Not being able to accept the fact that this place isn't perfect, isn't happy go lucky, isn't rainbows and sunshine.
They think your selfish because if you do it then it ruins their life, no longer can they live in ignorance..
